request.style: English, female solo voice with backing choir, acoustic guitar, drums, cello, electric guitar, uplifting pop anthem, 120 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord
Handed over to Midian for seven long years
They hid in caves and strongholds in the mountains
Crops destroyed and livestock taken away

[Pre-Chorus]
Crying out to the Lord in their distress
Gideon heard the call to fight

[Chorus]
A sword for the Lord and for Gideon
Three hundred men with trumpets sounding
Smashing the jars and lighting the torches
The army fled in panic and fear

[Verse]
Messengers sent to the hill country of Ephraim
Seize the waters ahead of the enemy
Capture the two commanders Oreb and Zeeb
Killed at the rock that bears his name

[Chorus]
A sword for the Lord and for Gideon
Three hundred men with trumpets sounding
Smashing the jars and lighting the torches
The army fled in panic and fear

[Bridge]
Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb
A reminder of God’s mighty judgment
As he struck Midian at the rock of Oreb
Deliverance for the people of the Lord

[Outro]
Fuel for the fire of their destruction
The Lord of hosts raises his whip
